info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Gardening Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Gardening Jacket Detail Management API facilitates the creation of detailed entries for gardening jackets in the product catalog. This API allows businesses to provide comprehensive information about each gardening jacket, including features, specifications, and pricing details. Retailers and inventory managers can utilize this API to ensure accurate and up-to-date product representations in their systems. By enabling targeted management of gardening jacket details, this API supports enhanced customer decision-making and inventory control.

post.summary: Create a new gardening jacket detail entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a detailed entry for a gardening jacket, including specifications and features. It is designed for developers looking to manage product details efficiently.

requestBody.description: Submit details for a gardening jacket. This request allows you to provide specific attributes related to the gardening jacket, such as size, color, and additional features, ensuring that the product is tailored to your needs.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning detailed information about the gardening jacket.
